changelog: Upgrading signs every user out once. A password change now ends every existing session: each token carries a keyed fingerprint of the password hash it was issued against, and one that no longer matches is rejected.

BREAKING for remote agents: St0r now reaches remote agents over TLS with a pinned certificate. Existing remote agents stop answering until each is installed again ("Install agent" over SSH or a new install command); they keep their API keys. STOR_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP=true on the backend keeps them on plain HTTP in the meantime.
The agent no longer prints its API key to the journal or the installer output. It is only in the root-readable /etc/stor-agent/config.json.
The agent installer builds again. It ran npm install --omit=dev and then failed with tsc: not found; it now installs from a lockfile with dev dependencies and prunes them afterwards.
The one-line installer installs the latest GitHub release instead of a hard-coded 3.2.78, and records the version it actually installed.
Dependencies: axios 1.20, multer 2.3, mysql2 3.22, nodemailer 10.1 and in-range fixes. npm audit --omit=dev reports nothing for the backend, frontend or agent.
